steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Battle won. Battle command to protect object's return successfully. Hello.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>Human</color>? There is a complete human nervous system in my body. Is this considered human?

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: I am curious. You and I are very similar. Are you waiting for commands too?

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Agreed. I can generate commands based on the situation. You don't have this autonomy.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: I am delighted. As a tool, I am more outstanding.
A screw pops out from this outstanding robot maid.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Oh, no! This body is severely damaged. Finding a repair site... SALVA, prosthesis repair center.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Apply. Master, can you pay to repair the body of your cutest maid?
SALVA...? Better to wait until the battle is over and help her after returning to MBCC. The mechanical body can be repaired, but what about Labyrinth's memories?

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Mary? Searching database. Search completed. I only have the record of you, Master. Is it someone important to you? Would you like me to find her for you?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: ...Never mind. I don't know who she is either.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Coffee. Do you want any? It is a program I am proud of. It will surely make you happy.
